records.region: West Texas: Presidio and Jeff Davis county plain, Wild Horse Creek/Lobo Valley, Van Horn and the southern Salt Basin in Culberson County.
records.candidate_name_role: Bounded mapped component names only; no representative identity for the entire selected route.
records.material_pending_reason: Selected southeastern opening and complete westward transfer into Wild Horse Creek. Selected US90/Lobo Road field-drain crossings and eastern detour. Selected northern dryland through-connection from the mapped creek/draw end into the terminal Salt Basin playa.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The selected route begins southeast of the mapped Wild Horse Creek, meets its middle corridor, proceeds through Lobo Valley and east of Van Horn, then extends north beyond the mapped creek/draw to a Salt Basin playa. Salt Basin, Wylie Mountains and Van Horn are geographic context rather than whole-route hydronyms.
records.completion_scope: This bounded source pass is finished, but the river-group correspondence remains material-pending. Mapped named middle reaches and the actual terminal setting do not justify completion while the three selected through-link gaps remain. No additional acquisition or indefinite source expansion was undertaken.
records.supported_name_scope: Wild Horse Creek labels support the long middle valley corridor, while Wild Horse Draw is a local printed toponym by the northern mapped channel end. Their formal naming/alias relationship is unverified.

component_scope_limits: Wild Horse Creek is a bounded component candidate, not a name imposed on the southeastern opening or dryland terminal extension.
Wild Horse Draw is read as a local toponym; no formal alias equivalence or name boundary is asserted.
Salt Basin is regional/terminal-setting context, not an individual lake or river-group name.
Map dashed-channel depiction does not establish perennial flow or current water extent.
No isolated waterbody, basin membership, nearest label or model through-line is used to bridge a missing selected connection.
Null representative candidate means the name is unestablished in this pass, not that no local or official name exists.

records.region: Andean border-region upper drainage, Caracarani–Lluta valley and the Lluta coastal wetland north of Arica, Chile. The headward country assignment is not independently established here.
records.candidate_name_role: Bounded receiving-system candidate, not a completed whole-selection representative identity.
records.material_pending_reason: Three selected-route gaps remain: the extreme initial unnamed opening; the actual Chironta reservoir/dam through-connection; and the final southern coastal connector to the selected ending. Readable main-valley correspondence and a known receiving name do not close these gaps.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The selected route begins on the northwestern side of the upper drainage, enters the Caracarani setting, continues into the Lluta valley, turns west through the Chironta setting and lower valley, then ends south of the cartographic river-mouth course. The final coastal geometry is not silently substituted with the source mouth.
records.completion_scope: A bounded original-source pass covered the one selected fragment from opening to terminal. All stored parts were inspected against readable source cartography, but three material through-connection/opening intervals remain unestablished. This is not completed geographic correspondence, a completed naming-scope hold, or proof of hydraulic continuity along the entire model.
records.supported_name_scope: Río Lluta applies to the directly attributed receiving, middle and lower mapped course. Quebrada Caracarani / Q. Caracarani applies to its mapped upper reach. The extreme initial feeder remains unnamed in the inspected source attributes.

component_scope_limits: The extreme opening is not assigned a hydronym from nearby labels or basin membership.
The source services provide closely related-looking linework; separate service publication does not prove independent survey lineage.
The Chironta reservoir context does not establish the actual selected managed through-connection.
The mapped river mouth and lagoon belt cannot substitute for the complete selected southern coastal path.
No exact formal name-transition point, current lagoon configuration, present shoreline position or surveyed source point is asserted.

records.candidate_name_role: Bounded receiving-river/system candidate for the supported Coulee de Manuel and Bayou des Cannes approach, Mermentau corridor, lake passages and lower navigational channel. The initial landward opening and final coastal-strip connection are not established, so this is not a completed whole-selection representative identity.
records.material_pending_reason: The actual Mattie Lane/Tate Cove Road opening-to-Coulee de Manuel transfer and the final Kings Bayou waterbody-to-gulf passage across the Hackberry Beach coastal strip remain unestablished. The supported bayou, river, lake and navigational-channel links do not close these two land-crossing gaps.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The supported route follows Coulee de Manuel and the Bayou des Cannes approach into the Mermentau River, through Lake Arthur and Grand Lake, and along the lower river/navigational channel into the Kings Bayou setting. The actual opening crosses mapped land before reaching the coulee; the last selected segment crosses the Hackberry Beach coastal strip rather than an established waterway.
records.completion_scope: Six original bounded cartographic views were acquired and read, covering both selected fragments, all 37 parts, actual headward opening, intermediate joins, lake and managed-channel links, fragment transition, and actual terminal. The bounded investigation is finished, but full waterway correspondence is not complete because two material selected connections remain unsupported. One river_group_source_material_pending primary classification is retained.
records.supported_name_scope: Mapped Coulee de Manuel south of the unsupported Ville Platte opening, the southwestward receiving bayou corridor and Bayou des Cannes, the Mermentau receiving channel through Lake Arthur and Grand Lake, and lower Mermentau/navigational-channel passage into the Kings Bayou setting. This does not scalar-name the coulee, tributary bayous, lakes or all selected positions, and does not assert that the selected opening is a natural source.

component_scope_limits: The actual selected opening and final coastal-strip connection remain unestablished.
The supported Coulee de Manuel approach and tributary/lake components are not scalar-named Mermentau River.
The selected opening is not a verified natural source.
Formal registry status, historical name equivalence and Korean form were not verified.
Mapped navigational channels and wetland connections do not establish current flow direction, discharge, barrier operation or water levels.
Ordinary cartographic generalization and modeled bend shortcuts are present; no exact-bank, datum, full-geometry or model-error diagnosis was performed.

records.region: Marajó/Breves interior and estuarine-channel setting, Pará, Brazil. Actual river-name identity remains unestablished.
records.candidate_name_role: No geographically established whole-system candidate; discovery leads are not assigned names.
records.material_pending_reason: No substantive original map was inspected for this selection. The western opening, southern and northern interior excursions, southeastern approach, inter-fragment connection and actual terminal remain materially unestablished; catalogue extents and a nearby Parauaú discovery lead are insufficient.
records.geographic_disambiguation: No inspected original map establishes the selected western opening, substantial interior loop, fragment transition or actual terminal in the Marajó/Breves region. Candidate remains null and the single primary status is source-material pending.
records.completion_scope: The sole municipal-original attempt timed out with an incomplete body; a separately issued Navy news article was denied; the independently issued chart catalogue was read, but the sole necessary chart-original attempt returned502. No stopped source was retried. Other chart originals were left unrequested and are not labelled denied. Research ends with concrete material gaps, not completed name research.

component_scope_limits: No substantive permitted source cartography was read during this bounded pass.
The western opening, both substantial interior direction changes, all intermediate joins, the fragment transition and terminal remain material gaps.
Search snippets, catalogue sheet titles and broad delta membership do not establish a candidate or selected through-links.
The historical r125 Breves-map observations concern a different selected system; they are not reused as geographical proof for this selection.
The selected path was used only for orientation, without alteration, full-geometry acquisition or revalidation.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
